details: Corrects a real Xiaomi screenshot defect in the authenticated workspace: old ocean-workspace.js was injecting the blue whale, 'Живой океан', oversized 180px icons and a duplicate five-item dock on top of Pearl Rose; replaced in-place with a compact Pearl Rose header and kept the original functional six-tab studio navigation. Removed competing DOM appearance attribute without altering saved preferences. Existing pearl-rose-workspace.css replaced in place, no added theme CSS. The five mobile tabs and working studio TTK/library/PDF/projects/cloud routes remain intact. No APK rebuild. Desktop/device visual QA not yet complete.
